title: s a t n i p
cando: read and write your first words

about.text: In this lesson you learn the sounds s, a, t, n, i, p. You hear each sound, you write its letters, and then you read words and a short text with them.
goals: Say the sound each new letter makes
Join sounds together to read a word
Break a word into sounds to write it
Read the new words out loud

chapters.title: s a t n, and Your First Word
chapters.text:
This is Lesson 2.
Today you read your first word.
Four letters. Four sounds.
First. sss. Listen. sss.
Say it with me. sss. Hold it long.
Next. a. Short and open. a.
Say it with me. a. a. a.
Next. t. A quick tap. t.
Say it with me. t. t. t.
Last. nnn. Through your nose. nnn.
Say it with me. nnn.
Now the important part. Listen well.
sss. a. t.
Say them one after another. sss. a. t.
Now faster. sss-a-t.
Faster again. sat.
You just read a word.
Do it again. sss. a. t. Sat.
Now another. t. a. nnn. Tan.
And one more. a. t. At.
That is reading. Nothing else.
Say the sounds. Run them together.
One warning. Say the SOUND.
Not ess. Say sss.
Ess-ay-tee will never make sat.
sss-a-t makes sat.
Go and read your first words.

chapters.title: i and p
chapters.text:
Two more letters.
First. i. Short. i.
Say it with me. i. i. i.
It is the sound in in. And in it.
Next. p. A puff of air. p.
Put your hand near your mouth.
Say p. Feel the air on your hand.
Say it with me. p. p. p.
Now join them with what you know.
p. i. nnn. Pin.
Say it with me. p-i-n. Pin.
Now another. p. i. t. Pit.
And. t. i. p. Tip.
Listen to those two again. Pit. Tip.
The same three sounds, in a new order.
That is how English works.
Now three words you cannot sound out.
The. Is. And I.
Try the sounds on the. It does not work.
So you learn it by sight. Look. Say it. Look away. Say it.
The word I is one letter.
It does not say the sound in pin. It says its name. I.
The. Is. I. Three words. Learn them today.

sounds.about: A long hissing sound. sss, like a kettle.
A short open sound. a, as in ant.
A short tap of the tongue. t.
A humming sound through your nose. nnn.
A short sound. i, as in in.
A small puff of air from your lips. p.

reader.title: Nat Sat
reader.text:
Nat sat.
An ant sat.
A tan ant sat.
An ant sat. Nat sat.

canDo: I can say the sounds s, a, t, n, i, p.
I can read words like at and sat.
I can write a word from its sounds.
I can read a short text out loud.
